title: Nepal–Tibet Border Flash Floods Tracker Update — Oct 18, 2026
summary: No new verified developments since the 16 October update. Nepal Police figures (1,456 dead, 5,132 missing as of 14 October) remain the latest; search has ended and the focus is reconstruction. An unconfirmed report of a separate Budhi Gandaki landslide-dam flood on 11 October was not added pending a second source.

title: Nepal–Tibet Border Flash Floods Tracker Update — Oct 16, 2026
summary: Nepal Police figures as of 14 October put confirmed dead at 1,456 and missing at 5,132. The 40-day search phase has ended and the government has shifted to rehabilitation, with a cabinet-level meeting recommending NPR 559.17 billion for 504 reconstruction plans. No new events were found for the past week.
